description: Official React component for embedding Unlayer's drag-and-drop email editor. Load and save design JSON, listen to editor events, and export responsive HTML.
rules: Import EmailEditor from 'react-email-editor' (package root only). It is client-only; the bundle includes 'use client', so it works in Next.js App Router Client Components without next/dynamic.
Call editor methods through the ref (emailEditorRef.current?.editor), e.g. loadDesign, saveDesign and exportHtml, and only after onReady has fired.
Store the design JSON from saveDesign() or exportHtml() to reopen a design later with loadDesign(); send the exported html.
Pass Unlayer configuration through the options prop (for example projectId, displayMode, appearance, mergeTags).
Use renderToJson() from @unlayer/react-elements; loadDesign() in onReady; wait for design:loaded; exportHtml(). Guide: https://github.com/unlayer/react-email-editor/blob/master/docs/react-elements.md
The combined Elements/editor example requires React 18+. Persist edited design JSON to reopen it; regenerating the original React template replaces edits. JSON does not regenerate JSX.
